For the eleventh day of the spring sale there are a lot of new sales - and a couple really good games. I'm not going to cover all the games on sale, since they have a ton, but I'll pick some that I feel strongly about from each day.

Legend of Grimrock 2
An excellent sequel to Legend of Grimrock. The first game was all inside a dark dungeon, and this one expands to a colorful outside world - while still keeping the semi-turn based grid combat.

This is the best game I've played in the party-dungeon-crawler genre, and I'd heartily recommend giving it a shot if you like these. It has some light puzzles to keep everything interesting as well.

 

OTTTD
This is a very unlock-heavy tower defense game - you won't be getting perfect scores on each map the first time through, no matter how good you are. The graphics and tower types are solid, though I didn't like how you could only build four of the twelve types directly (the rest are upgrades from those four basic types).

 

Rymdkapsel
A simple strategy game that's really only an hour long, unless you feel like playing it a few times to get a better score. The process is pretty much the same each time though. The poor AI tended to ruin it late-game for me, if it wasn't for that I would have enjoyed it a lot more.

 

Frozen Synapse
This is the best concurrent turn-based game I've played, with very detailed controls for waiting, crouching, turning, etc on each of your soldiers. I love how even the guns have a strategic order of operations (shotguns shoot first in up close combat, etc).

You can play it with friends but it also has a decent single-player campaign. Perhaps not thrilling but a very well-designed strategic game.

 

ReignMaker
These genres didn't create a good mashup in my opinion, and the weird shape of some of the battle areas really ruins the whole concept of match-three and forces you to level special abilities just to rearrange the board.

 

Puddle
A liquid-physics game where you control everything from water to rocket fuel with just your left and right mouse buttons to tilt the level. It's an okay game overall, with some levels being far better than others. I would recommend playing on the hardest difficulty though, since the normal one just isn't challenging.

 

Beat Hazard Ultra
Beat hazard is a great Asteroids-type game played to your music - and the Ultra DLC does add quite a bit of content (extra enemies, etc). I'd highly recommend this if you want to chill to some music and blow up enemies - one of the best games in this genre.

 

Anomaly Warzone Earth
The sequel - Anomaly 2 - has similar gameplay, but all of the weird controls or imbalances of this game are fixed in that. So go pick up the sequel instead, you don't really need to play this one first.

 

Particulars
This wasn't a bad game but the story wasn't particularly interesting to me, and the gameplay wasn't cohesive. Basically every single puzzle/minigame is different, so it feels pretty shallow - rather than letting you get invested and improve in one cool type of game.

 

Monster Loves You
This is kind of a choose your own adventure game. There's a lot of text and you choose particular actions to perform as your monster grows into adulthood. This shapes how strong, brave, etc you are - and ultimately determines how the monsters interact with humans.

It was okay but not as engaging as I'd hoped - I liked watching Jesse Cox play it more than I enjoyed playing it myself. I just didn't feel that invested in my choices or monster.

There are multiple endings, so you can play it through a number of times - although you will run into the same answers if you repeat certain actions.

 

Saints Row 4
If you liked Saints Row 3 you'll probably enjoy this one - it's more of the same over-the-top action, but this time you also have superhero powers. Cars and planes are almost obsolete since you can run faster and fly on your own, and this makes getting around much more pleasant. Really it has every activity and character the previous game had, rebranded differently, but has a more comic book flavor.

Oh and the title intro to this game is absolutely fantastic.
